title: What does it take to implement identity verification, and how long does it take? | Identity Infrastructure Explained
summary: Implementing identity verification takes a few days of integration and 1 day to 3 weeks to launch. Stages, timings, delays and the move to eID-first.
body_markdown:
*The stages of an identity verification implementation, how long each one takes and what most often delays the launch.*


Implementing identity verification through an identity orchestration platform has several stages: access to a test environment, configuration, technical integration, testing, production launch and a pilot. With Authologic, the first test verification can run straight after registration, and the technical part can be completed in a few days. Business and compliance decisions on the client's side usually take longest, along with the formalities some methods require, especially government ones.


*Written by Helena Suska (Head of Customer Success) and Krzysztof Klimczak (Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer), Authologic.*
